name: capcut_set_clip_speed
description: Sets playback speed multiplier (e.g. 0.5x slow-mo, 1.25x talking head, 2.0x time-lapse) with optional pitch preservation so voices do not sound like chipmunks.

preserve_pitch.description: If true, preserves original audio pitch when altering speed.

segment_id.description: UUID of the video or audio segment.

speed.description: Speed multiplier (e.g. 0.5 for half speed, 1.2 for faster speech, 2.0 for double speed).
